`font8x9.png` and `../gint/keycodes.h` are copied from gint revision badbd0fd2bd8ac796fd55d49b93691741bd8a139 for host visual/key testing. Upstream: https://git.planet-casio.com/Lephenixnoir/gint . The upstream README permits use, sharing and modification for any purpose. Font conversion follows its fxconv metadata: print charset, 8x11 grid, padding 1, proportional trimming, line height 9, spacing 1. This host adapter does not emulate calculator hardware or gint drivers.
